Arrows are not slowed down when moving through water.
These effects are not applied to Tipped or Spectral Arrows.

jei.better_tools.crystallite_sword_gold_: Spin Attack damage increases by 10% per level of Sweeping Edge.
jei.better_tools.crystallite_sword_honey: Attack Damage Combo will be lost after 2s of no attacks.
jei.better_tools.crystallite_upgrade_inf:
Initially obtained through trading a Crystallite Gem with a Jeweller Villager.
Can be duplicated using Crystallite Shards and 7 Diamonds.
jei.better_tools.diamond_crystallite_inf:
§lCrystallite Upgrades: 
§bDiamond§r

Theme:
Protection and Durability
All other stats increase slightly too!
jei.better_tools.effect_armor_jei_inform:
§lEffect Armor§r

Applies an effect to the wearer, as long as they don't already have the effect.
An Energy Vial must be equipped to supply Effect Energy to the armor.

When there is sufficient energy, the effect is applied every 5 seconds.
Upgraded Effect Armor pieces have lower energy costs and stronger effects.
Wearing multiple pieces of Effect Armor at once gives a discount in energy cost.
jei.better_tools.electric_chaining_info:
§6Electric Chaining§r
An Electric Chain damages any mobs it touches.
Any mob hit by an Electric Chain has a chance to continue the chain.
jei.better_tools.elemental_crystals_info:
§lElemental Crystals§r

Use in a Smithing Table to upgrade Crystallite equipment with different elemental effects!
They can also be used to craft Crystallite Charms.
jei.better_tools.ender_titanium_ore_gen_:
§lOre Generation§r
§5Ender Titanium Ore§r

Generates below y=30, in the End Islands.
Spawns rarely, in small groups.
jei.better_tools.ender_titanium_upgrade_: Found with a 1/16 chance in End City chest loot.
jei.better_tools.energy_vials_info:
Store Effect Energy in this vial to power your Effect Armor.
Access the Energy Vial Menu by pressing §3[V]§r with the vial equipped, or by right-clicking with the vial in your main hand.
In this menu, you can fuel the vial with Effect Energy using Enriched Blaze Powder.
You can also configure which armor pieces this vial should power.
This allows the effects of Effect Armor to be toggled on/off freely, without needing to take the armor off!
jei.better_tools.enriched_blaze_powder_i:
Use this to fuel an Energy Vial with Effect Energy.
This is essential for using Effect Armor.
jei.better_tools.fire_effects_info: Effect improves when used in the Nether
jei.better_tools.fire_staff_info:
§4When enchanted with Ensorcellation:§r
Projectiles become explosive.
Explosion Power increases with level, and when in the Nether.
jei.better_tools.frozen_info:
§bFrozen Mobs§r
Frozen mobs cannot move or jump.
Attack them to shatter the ice, dealing §9+3 Damage§r.
Frozen Players can jump repeatedly to shorten the effect time.
jei.better_tools.guardian_staff_info:
§3When enchanted with Ensorcellation:§r
Increases the damage and range of the Water Pulse.

Damage: +1 per level.
Radius: +2 per level.


§3When it is wet:§r
Damage and Range both increase by 50%
jei.better_tools.ice_effects_info: Effect improves when used in a cold biome
jei.better_tools.ice_staff_info:
§9When enchanted with Ensorcellation:§r
Projectiles freeze all mobs in a radius.
This applies even when no mob is directly hit.
Radius increases with level, and in a cold biome.
jei.better_tools.icy_bracelet_info:
Adds §9+10% Freeze Chance§r for any melee attacks.
This stacks with any Sapphire weapons, and any Bows enchanted with Freeze Shot.
In a cold biome, this chance doubles.
jei.better_tools.improved_luck_info:
Four Leaf Clovers can be found in Treehouse chest loot, and they are used to brew Luck Potions.
Four Leaf Clovers can be bone-mealed to grow more of them.


§lImproved Luck Effect§r
Having an increased Luck value gives a chance for ores to drop double!
It also increases the chance for additional effects of items to activate.
The chance increase is +5% per +1 Luck
jei.better_tools.infinite_arrows_info:
When no Arrows are in the user's inventory, this bow will shoot regular Arrows.
If any regular Arrows are in the inventory, they will not be used up.
Tipped and Spectral Arrows are used up normally.
jei.better_tools.jewellery_table_info:
This is the workstation for the Jeweller Villager profession.
Trade with this villager to get Crystallite Charms, or duplicate Charm Bases, without even needing any Crystallite!
Also sells Crystallite Upgrade Smithing Templates.
jei.better_tools.lapis_crystallite_info:
§lCrystallite Upgrades: 
§9Lapis Lazuli§r

Theme:
Magic and Enchanting
All items in this set have very high enchantability!
jei.better_tools.lightning_effects_info:
Effect improves when used in a thunderstorm
(Must be in a location which can see the sky)
jei.better_tools.lightning_staff_info:
§6When enchanted with Ensorcellation:§r
Increases the number of Lightning Strikes.
Increases the radius where the strikes can hit.
Number of strikes increases with level, and when in a thunderstorm.
When the projectile hits a Lightning Rod, a lightning bolt will be summoned.
jei.better_tools.lost_souls_potion_info:
Teleports you to your last death location, if it is in the same dimension.
It will fail if you died in lava, or inside a solid block.
If you died in the void, you will be placed on a small floating platform.
jei.better_tools.metal_blocks_info: To use Metal Blocks, first use a Stonecutter to make White Metal Blocks, then dye them into your desired colour.
jei.better_tools.mixed_ore_gen_info:
§lOre Generation§r

Generates below y=40
Becomes more common the deeper you go.
Spawns in small veins.
jei.better_tools.multi_block_mining_tool: Multi-block mining effect is disabled while crouching
jei.better_tools.mystic_potion_info:
Use this potion to brew powerful utility potions.
Applies a random effect for up to 30s when consumed.
Careful - the effects may be helpful or harmful!
jei.better_tools.nature_ring_info:
Base healing rate: §91HP every 8s§r

Healing is §ltwice as fast§r when:
- Under 50% HP
- In Sunlight
- Both items are worn
(These x2 multipliers can stack for up to §91s Regen Speed§r)
jei.better_tools.nether_diamond_armor_in: Max Burn Time decreases when more armor pieces are worn.
jei.better_tools.nether_diamond_ore_gen_:
§lOre Generation§r
§4Nether Diamond Ore§r

Generates at any y-level, in §4Basalt Deltas§r only.
Only generates inside of §8Blackstone§r clumps.
Spawns in medium-sized veins.
jei.better_tools.netherite_crystallite_i:
§lCrystallite Upgrades: 
§8Netherite§r

Damage and The Nether
All stats increase slightly too!
jei.better_tools.obtaining_crystallite_i:
§lObtaining Crystallite§r

Find Crystallite Clusters underground by listening out for their sparkle!
They spawn rarely between y=-48 and y=46.
They do not spawn above y=0 in oceans.
Mine Crystallite Blocks with a §lNetherite Pickaxe§r or better.
Each block drops 1 Crystallite Shards item, which can be used to craft Gems for crafting tools and armor.
Crystallite Gems are also used to craft Elemental Crystals.
jei.better_tools.ore_vision_info:
§lOre Vision Effect§r
Displays particles on all ores within a 24 block radius
jei.better_tools.progressive_tools_info:
These tools have improved abilities after they have been used for a while.
For all tools, breaking any correct block for that tool counts as a use.
For hoes, tilling farmland also counts as a use.
jei.better_tools.purple_mushroom_info:
Purple Mushrooms generate in Fungal Caves, along with giant variants.
They can be bone-mealed to become giant, if there is enough space.
Standing on one makes you take damage, however!
jei.better_tools.quark_monster_box_info:
If Quark is installed:
Can drop from mobs spawned by a Monster Box.
jei.better_tools.recall_potion_info:
Teleports you to your current spawn point, if it is in the same dimension.
In the Overworld, if it is obstructed, you will be placed at the world spawn instead.
To use in the Nether, you must have a Respawn Anchor with charges remaining.
jei.better_tools.reduced_detection_range: Reduced Detection Range effect only works in singleplayer worlds.

Most common at y=-32 and y=32
Spawns in small veins.
jei.better_tools.safe_honey_harvesters_i: Can safely harvest honey from beehives, without angering nearby bees.

jei.better_tools.stuck_in_mud_info:
§lPitfall Effect§r
If the target is grounded, they will get stuck in the mud. Otherwise, they will be forced downwards.
When a mob is stuck in the ground, it cannot move.
It can still attack, however.
If a player jumps, they are instantly freed from the effect.
jei.better_tools.sugar_clump_info: When multiple Sugar Clumps are eaten in a row, the duration of the Speed effect increases accordingly.
jei.better_tools.supplementaries_urns_in:
If Supplementaries is installed:
Can drop from Cave Urns.
jei.better_tools.thorns_damage_info:
§lThorns Damage§r

Some armor pieces deal Thorns damage 100% of the time.
This only applies to §lmelee attackers.

jei.better_tools.topaz_pickaxe_info:
May duplicate drops from ores, as long as the ore block itself is not dropped.
Stacks with Fortune.
jei.better_tools.utility_potions_info:
§lUtility Potions§r

These give various one-off effects when consumed.
They spawn in Mineshaft and Dungeon chest loot, or they can be brewed manually.
jei.better_tools.warden_staff_info:
§1When enchanted with Ensorcellation:§r
Increases the damage and range of the Sonic Boom.

Damage: +2 per level.
Range: +3 per level.
jei.better_tools.winged_boots_info:
Allows double jumping in mid-air.
Uses up Effect Energy for each jump, so an Energy Vial must be equipped with sufficient energy.
